purpose: Fail closed before and throughout realtime reflection-probe synchronization unless the machine-readable material registry still matches actual active Unity Material assets, the persisted facade glazing gasket remains structurally/materially valid, the deterministic smooth LOD0 sash-latch crescent assets and curve-preserving LOD1 proxies are prepared before the first probe baseline then remain unchanged, and the period-plausible metal crescent-latch replacement is prepared before the first probe baseline then remains unchanged. This protects the cubemap baseline from physically invalid/stale materials and from MainCamera-only facade-interface, latch-curve or first-LOD-transition state; it does not award Visual Fidelity points.
limitations: The binding proves source/runtime material-contract coherence plus persisted glazing-gasket, smooth LOD0 latch-curve, curve-preserving LOD1 proxy and sash-latch construction coherence at each reflection-lighting fingerprint evaluation; it does not prove final BRDF appearance, filtered texture response, Fresnel behavior or highlight plausibility.

The glazing-gasket validation proves the persisted structural state sent to ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe; it does not prove that the 10 mm interface is visually proportionate, free of black-halo artifacts or free of subpixel shimmer in final camera views.

The curve refinement binding proves that the exact 32-ring swept LOD0 crescent asset set is present before the first probe baseline and unchanged after epoch arm; it cannot prove that 32 rings are visually sufficient, that the 10 mm section is proportionate, or that grazing highlights are free of faceting/shimmer.

The LOD-continuity binding proves that the exact first proxy keeps a 16-ring crescent with the same physical curve envelope as LOD0 and remains unchanged after epoch arm; it cannot prove that the 32-to-16-ring cross-fade is perceptually invisible, free of shimmer or free of highlight snap in motion.

The sash-latch binding proves that the old rubber handle renderers are disabled and the metal lock/receiver/LOD state is stable after the first pre-probe preparation; it cannot prove the reconstructed dimensions look proportionate or that the small hardware avoids aliasing at 4K.

A passing binding cannot clear impossible_material_physics, visible_lod_pop, severe_aliasing_or_shimmer or any other critical defect without sealed native-4K rendered evidence and required frontal/oblique/grazing review.
Unity compile/runtime behavior remains unverified until a real Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner executes the packet.
